course.title: Khaemenes Higher Learning Abstract Algebra
course.audience: Advanced undergraduates, graduate-preparatory learners, and independent researchers entering algebra, number theory, geometry, topology, coding, cryptography, or theoretical computer science.
course.prerequisite: Introduction to Proofs or equivalent proof fluency is required. Linear Algebra and Discrete Mathematics are strongly recommended; number-theory familiarity is helpful
course.credit_guidance: An advanced upper-level and graduate-preparatory abstract algebra sequence with selected beginning-graduate topics. It is not represented as a replacement for a university graduate algebra qualifying sequence.
